spec.description: The load signal that matters. Average pulling away from the 60 target is what players experience as degradation, and it moves before any resource metric does.
spec.title: Tick rate

spec.description: Both series are percentages of the container's CPU limit, so they share one axis. Throttling is the one that hurts: it stalls the game thread mid-tick and every player feels it at once.
spec.title: CPU

spec.description: Percentage of the container memory limit. An OOM kill disconnects every player at once, so headroom here matters more than the absolute number.
spec.title: Memory

spec.description: Magnitude by category, so one hue rather than a colour per species — the bar length carries the value and the names are read directly off the rows.
spec.title: Species

spec.description: Ordered bands from hatchling to fully grown, so the ramp runs light to dark rather than using unrelated hues.
spec.title: Growth

spec.description: Distance from the group centre, in metres. Clustering is what drives replication cost up faster than player count alone — a tick rate dip with this falling means everyone piled into one place.
spec.title: How spread out players are

spec.description: How long people stay. A median collapsing toward a couple of minutes means players are joining and leaving again, which the player count alone will not show because the seat gets refilled.
spec.title: Session length

spec.description: Live player count from the A2S query port.
spec.title: Players online

spec.description: Entries still in force in the game's own ban, mute and whitelist files. An enforced whitelist reading zero rejects every join while the server otherwise looks healthy.
spec.title: Moderation lists

spec.description: Most players within the configured cluster radius of any one player.
spec.title: Biggest group

spec.description: The in-game clock as the server reports it.
spec.title: Game time of day

spec.description: Successful pulses per minute to the Alderon server list. If this stops, the server vanishes from the public list and nobody new can find it — while it keeps running, holds tick rate and answers queries normally.
spec.title: Server-list heartbeat

spec.description: Failures reaching the BattlEye master. While these occur, bans are not being verified.
spec.title: BattlEye master

spec.description: The two exporters this dashboard depends on. If either drops, the panels above go stale rather than wrong — check here first when something looks frozen.
spec.title: Collectors up

spec.description: Average server tick rate. The server targets 60. Sustained drops below ~48 are what players feel as lag, and this moves before CPU or memory show anything.
spec.title: Tick rate

spec.description: Connected players whose Alderon ID appears in the server's admin list.
spec.title: Admins online

spec.description: Whether the server answers A2S queries. Independent of whether it is listed publicly.
spec.title: Server reachable

spec.description: The map the server is running and the weather it currently reports. ServerMap=Island is the Gondwa map.
spec.title: Map / weather

spec.description: Single series, so no legend is needed — the title names it. The dashed line is the configured slot cap.
spec.title: Players online

spec.description: Turnover rate. Joins persistently outrunning leaves with a flat player count means people are bouncing straight back out.
spec.title: Joins and leaves per hour
